name: Tone.js
role: Web Audio framework for synths, sequencing and effects; Tone.Offline renders faster than real time
summary: Web Audio wrapper with instruments, effects, and a Transport for scheduling in musical time. For VCR the useful path is Tone.Offline, which renders a scheduled piece into an AudioBuffer off the real-time clock, so audio is a function of the score, not wall time. Output is a buffer you encode to WAV and mux with ffmpeg. Live playback during headless capture is not deterministic.
use_when: Generating a music bed or UI sound effects from code, synced to a beat grid
Over raw Web Audio when you want instruments, effects and a Transport
Offline-rendering audio to a WAV that ffmpeg muxes under the video
avoid_when: Only filtering or mixing existing files: ffmpeg
Audio-reactive visuals from a file: Web Audio AnalyserNode or ffmpeg analysis
A few oscillators or gain ramps: raw Web Audio avoids the dependency
notes: 2026-10-26: npm `latest` is 15.1.22 (2025-04-27) while `next` builds 15.5.x were published through 2026-10-25. Tone.Offline behaviour is from general knowledge; the README fetched did not mention it.

assessment.rationale: Repo pushed 2026-10-25 and next builds published through Oct 2026, though the stable npm tag is 18 months old. MIT. Only audio-synthesis library in the catalogue.
